head: Paramount+ and HBO Max bundle coming in early 2027
dek: Skydance, which now owns both, plans to offer Paramount+ and HBO Max together for one price from early 2027. It hasn't given prices yet.
details: Skydance CEO David Ellison called the bundle a first step toward one combined service later. The company didn't say whether other bundles, such as HBO Max with Disney+ and Hulu, will continue; it said it would look at them. More details are due in the coming months.
means: If you pay for both services, you may be able to pay one bill for both next year.
todo: Keep your current plans for now and compare once Skydance shares the bundle price.
thumb_words: PARAMOUNT+ AND HBO MAX IN ONE
